SSC CHSL 10+2 Online Form 2026 (2536 Posts) – Full Details

Staff Selection Commission, SSC has released a Notification for the post of Combined Higher Secondary Level Examination 2026 on the official website of SSC. This recruitment was released for 2536 posts. Applications for the SSC CHSL 10+2 Recruitment 2026 has Started from 07 September 2026, & Candidate can apply untill 08 October 2026. Candidates must check complete details for SSC CHSL 10+2 Recruitment 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 07 September 2026
  • Last Date : 07 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 08 October 2026
  • Online Correction : 14 – 16 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • All Category Female : 0/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
